subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Theca Lutein Cysts, Suction Evacuation and hCG Surveillance

steps.tx: Large bilateral ovarian cysts driven by very high hCG in molar pregnancy are **theca lutein cysts**. They can reach fifteen centimetres and make ovaries feel like grapefruit sized masses. They resolve spontaneously as hormone falls after evacuation. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Theca lutein cysts enlarge both ovaries under very high hCG and resolve after evacuation.

steps.tx: Removing molar tissue with suction under ultrasound guidance is **suction evacuation**. It is safer than sharp curettage for the soft, vascular molar uterus. An experienced operator and cross matched blood are standing precautions. Correlating this finding with imaging and laboratory results prevents both delayed treatment and unnecessary intervention in most patients.
steps.say: Suction evacuation removes molar tissue more safely than sharp curettage.

steps.tx: Serial beta hCG measurement after evacuation until negative and beyond is **hCG surveillance**. Weekly values plot a fall that should be smooth and progressive. Plateau or rise on consecutive samples defines neoplasia needing chemotherapy. Early recognition matters because timely treatment gives clearly better outcomes than waiting for complications to develop first.
steps.say: hCG surveillance plots weekly falls, and plateau or rise defines neoplasia.

steps.tx: Criteria for starting chemotherapy include plateaued or rising hormone, histological choriocarcinoma and metastatic disease, grouped as **treatment triggers**. A hormone still high six months after evacuation also qualifies. Specialist centres apply these uniformly. Students should connect this fact with the presenting symptoms, since examination questions usually test that clinical link directly.
steps.say: Treatment triggers include plateaued hormone, choriocarcinoma histology and metastases.

steps.tx: Theca lutein cysts occasionally twist or rupture, causing acute abdomen termed **cyst accident**. Most still settle conservatively because surgery on these ovaries risks oophorectomy. Aspiration under imaging helps tense symptomatic cysts rarely. Documenting this finding clearly in the notes guides the next clinician and supports safe, well planned further management.
steps.say: Cyst accidents from theca lutein cysts usually settle conservatively to preserve ovaries.

steps.tx: Reliable contraception during surveillance prevents a new pregnancy confusing hormone trends, a rule of **surveillance contraception**. Oral contraceptives are safe after hormone normalises per current guidance. Pregnancy is deferred until follow up completes. When this picture is seen in practice, urgent senior review is wise whenever there is any doubt about severity.
steps.say: Surveillance contraception prevents new pregnancy confusing hormone trends during follow up.

steps.tx: Duration of follow up differs by mole type, longer after complete mole, reflecting **risk based duration**. Partial mole follow up ends sooner after hormone normalisation. Centres issue individual end dates in writing. Understanding this mechanism explains the symptoms, the investigation findings and the logic behind each step of treatment given.
steps.say: Risk based duration follows complete moles longer than partial moles after normalisation.

steps.tx: Respiratory distress during evacuation from trophoblast deportation to lungs is **trophoblastic embolisation**. Large moles with high hormone levels carry the risk. Supportive oxygen and ventilation tide most patients over as it resolves. This distinction changes management, so it should be settled early rather than after empirical treatment has already begun.
steps.say: Trophoblastic embolisation during evacuation causes respiratory distress needing supportive ventilation.

steps.tx: Women are warned that future pregnancies usually proceed normally, termed **future pregnancy counselling**. Recurrence risk is about one in eighty after one mole, rising after two. Early scan and post delivery hormone check guard each future pregnancy. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Future pregnancy counselling reassures that most next pregnancies proceed normally.
